reviews.title: Prix Premium. L’expérience, de moins en moins.
reviews.text:
Abonné Premium depuis plusieurs années, je trouve de plus en plus difficile de justifier les augmentations régulières du prix de l’abonnement.

Le plus agaçant reste l’apparition de publicités intempestives pendant les podcasts, alors même que je paie un abonnement Premium. Certaines publicités sont même diffusées en néerlandais, sans aucun rapport avec ma langue.

Payer toujours plus cher pour un service « Premium » tout en subissant de la publicité est franchement décevant. Spotify devrait au minimum garantir une expérience réellement sans publicité à ses abonnés Premium.

reviews.title: "Parlez-moi d'IA", une émission passionnante et nécessaire
reviews.text:
Excellent ! Les sujets abordés sont à chaque fois passionnants, très actuels et surtout nécessaires. Parlez-moi d’IA a cette qualité rare de s’intéresser à l’intelligence artificielle sous l’angle de l’intérêt général, en donnant la parole à celles et ceux qui cherchent concrètement à construire des solutions utiles, responsables et porteuses de sens.

C’est particulièrement stimulant de découvrir toutes ces personnes et ces initiatives qui travaillent déjà à faire émerger un avenir meilleur. Une émission qui permet de mieux comprendre les transformations en cours, tout en ouvrant des perspectives positives et inspirantes. À écouter absolument !

reviews.title: 🌟Spotify заслужава  5 звезди
reviews.text:
Spotify е едно от най-добрите приложения за музика, които съм използвал! 🎧🔥 Харесва ми, че мога да намирам почти всякаква музика, да си правя собствени плейлисти и да откривам нови песни и изпълнители. Препоръките също са много добри и често ми показват песни, които наистина ми харесват.

Харесва ми и колко лесно се използва приложението – всичко е подредено удобно и мога бързо да намеря това, което искам да слушам. Spotify е идеален за слушане вкъщи, навън, по време на път или просто когато искам да си почина с любимата ми музика. 🎶

Благодаря на целия екип на Spotify за страхотното приложение и за постоянните подобрения! ❤️ Продължавайте да го развивате, защото Spotify определено е едно от приложенията, без които не бих искал да оставам. 👑🔥

reviews.title: Твърде сложно е да се купи абонамент
reviews.text: Непрестанно музиката бива прекъсвана от реклами да се абонирам, а когато натисна линка ми казва, че няма как да се случи това през приложението и се отказвам всеки път. В крайна сметка каква е целта ви? Да се абонирам или да слушам реклами? Защото за да направя абонамент към вас, трябва собственоръчно да напиша отделен линк в браузъра, да си знам имейла с който съм регистрирана ( което няма как да проверя в профила си в приложението) и става абсурдно сложно. Направете директен линк за плащане и ще имате повече абонати. Абсурдно е такава голяма платформа да не изпипа този очевиден детайл.

reviews.title: Stop the feedback POPUP spam!!!
reviews.text:
The service itself? Perfectly fine. It works just as you’d expect. But the real highlight has to be the popup window asking for feedback. I mean, who doesn’t enjoy a cheerful little box jumping onto the screen right at the moment you’re actually focused on something, asking if you have “just a minute” to write a review? Incredible. Truly a gift.
The timing of these popups is almost touching. It’s as if they’re specially trained to appear at the exact micro‑second when you’re in the middle of something important. They yank your attention away so efficiently that you almost start to question why we even bother trying to concentrate. Clearly, multitasking wasn’t chaotic enough already.
Of course, it’s understandable that companies want to know what their users think. That part makes sense. But constantly interrupting your workflow feels a bit like someone quietly tapping your chair every few minutes just to ask if everything is still okay. It doesn’t exactly sharpen your focus.
A more subtle, less in-your-face way of collecting feedback—perhaps one that doesn’t explode into the center of your screen—would do wonders for the overall experience. Until then, it remains a small daily challenge: try using what you came here to use while your screen politely but persistently reminds you how valuable your opinion is.

reviews.title: Getting worse and worse
reviews.text:
This app gets slower and more expensive every single year, but the recent updates have completely broken it. Ever since Spotify rolled out the AI DJ feature, the app lags constantly. It stutters on load, freezes when switching tracks, and buffers endlessly even on offline playlists.
You’re paying higher subscription prices for a bloated app filled with unremovable features you didn’t ask for, while the core music player barely functions. To make matters worse, despite charging subscribers more, Spotify continues to pay artists fractions of a cent per stream.
Save your money. Between the terrible performance, constant price hikes, and unfair artist payouts, it's not worth keeping Premium anymore.

reviews.title: Stupide voorspellingen en achteruit in het luisteren van podcasts
reviews.text:
Als je van een muzieksoort houdt die niet echt onder een genre valt of waarvan spotify niet begrijpt dat het een genre op zich is, krijg je de meest debiele voorspellingen. Wat veel vervelender is. Als je een podcast luistert, gebeurt het om de haverklap dat je ineens een oudere aflevering voorgeschoteld krijgt. Of dat je, als je voorbij een bepaalde aflevering bent, stomweg per aflevering terug wordt gestuurd naar nul. Aangezien deze functies (handsfree luisteren in de auto naar wat je wél interesseert) de enige reden is om spotify te gebruiken, denk ik dat ik maar gewoon mn abonnementje ga opzeggen. Het is al tijdrovend genoeg om een interessante podcast te vinden, dan moet je ook niet nog eens voor elke rit een playlist hoeven aanmaken.

Edit, nog niks gewijzigd. Nu ook nog een heleboel AI troep. Einde abbo. Apple Music Here I come

reviews.title: Great source of music, interface remains chaotic
reviews.text:
With the (expensive) paid version, this app comes to life and the usability is improved simply because one can actually select an individual song. 
Some downsides remain:
- algorithm is too simple, it is hard to get out of your music bubble
- the UX/UI is terrible. Extremely chaotic. Hard to find what you want. The carplay version is even worse where you cannot look for songs or artists without having to use spoken input. 

Music quality is fine for where I play this music. And also, it always works. I cannot recall that the app or service didn’t work.

reviews.title: Werbung trotz Family Basic Abo
reviews.text:
Prinzipiell tolle App.

Seit einiger Zeit habe ich mit meiner Familie ein Family Basic Abo. Am Anfang hatten wir natürlich noch keine Werbung, vor ca. einem-zwei Monat(en) wurde damit angefangen, 2 Werbungen je 25sec zu senden, aber ich konnte sie trotzdem sofort überspringen. Heute habe ich bemerkt, dass jetzt selbst mit Basic Family Abo 3 Werbungen je 25(!) sec gezeigt werden und diese nicht übersprungen werden können.

Liebes Spotify Team, daher die Frage: 
1)warum so viel und lange Werbung trotz Abo? Ich finde das eine Frechheit, da kann man gleich auf YouTube schauen und hat gefühlt weniger Werbung.
2)Könnten Sie bitte ändern, dass man mehrere Songs in einer Playlist auswählen kann, um sie zu einer anderen Playlist hinzuzufügen?

Now comes the gym to the story it’s impossible to delete the old credit cards from Spotify or verify, if something with wrong with the input given to them, which shouldn’t be the case because the credit card went through a verification process to show up in the Spotify list. I will be looking for a way to message somebody at Spotify directly but that possibility seems to be buried or nonexistent. What a waste of a day.

reviews.title: Bad
reviews.text:
I am a student and was using the Student Premium plan. At some point, Spotify switched me to the regular Premium plan, which costs twice as much (€12 instead of the student price). I had no reasonable way to continue paying for it, so I simply canceled the subscription and planned to use the free version.

What happened next was shocking. Instead of allowing me to listen with ads like a normal free user, Spotify practically locked my entire account. Every time I opened the app and tried to play any song, playlist, or album, all I got was a screen telling me to upgrade to Premium. Nothing would play. No music, no podcasts, nothing. The app became completely unusable.

This feels extremely manipulative and unfair, especially for students who cannot afford a full Premium subscription. If I cancel Premium, I should be able to use the free version, not have the entire service blocked behind constant upgrade screens.

Very disappointing experience. Spotify should treat its users with more respect instead of pushing them into subscriptions by making the app unusable.

reviews.title: Bug copertine dei File locali su iPhone
reviews.text:
Da qualche giorno le copertine dei miei File locali non vengono più visualizzate nella schermata “In riproduzione” su iPhone. Le copertine invece sono presenti nella playlist, si vedono sulla schermata di blocco e sul PC, quindi i file e le immagini sono corretti. Ho già aggiornato Spotify e provato a disattivare e riattivare i File locali, ma il problema rimane.
Uso un iPhone 13 e prima le copertine venivano visualizzate normalmente. Spero possiate risolvere questo bug presto perché è piuttosto fastidioso.

reviews.title: Bellissima e adatta a chi si sente solo
reviews.text: Mi piace tantissimo questa app per me che ascolto tanta musica e ogni tanto amo variare, quindi mi metto una playlist con il premium che ho attivato e questa è già una cosa fantastica che altre app non fanno secondo me. Oltre a questo mi piace la funzione social dove posso avere dei follower, poter seguire le persone, potergli salvare le playlist ecc. però consiglierei di reintrodurre la messaggistica e attivarla anche per gli adoolescenti minori di 16 anni proprio come me perché è proprio in questo periodo che si deve socializzare. Poi per chi come me non ha social pubblici come Instagram e Facebook è più conveniente usare Spotify per conoscere gente nuova, stringere amicizie sempre rimanendo nelle giuste norme di sicurezza e creare gruppi tra amici per condividere i brani. Inoltre consiglierei una funzione avantaggiata: come una vera chat che si rispetti, dovrebbe essere introdotta la videochiamata e la chiamata vocale. Non dico come su WhatsApp ma simile, almeno poter interagire con una persona, ad esempio se una persona ascolta un brano e vuole consigliarlo a me mi fa uno squillo rimanendo dentro l'app. Dico: sarebbero un sogno queste cose che ho detto ma è solo un parere mio. Non preoccupatevi di migliorare tutto adesso.

Avete aumentato canone mensile di 2€ in più in pochissimi anni 

È da più di 10 anni che pago SPOTIFY e sono stato indiscutibilmente tra i primi ascoltatori a credere nella vostra app!

1) Negli ultimi anni gli algoritmi suggeriscono musiche sbagliate e diverse dalle mie preferite!
2) Dopo tanti anni che pago abbonamento PREMIUM siete passati da 9,99€ a 10,99€ al mese senza fare offerte mirate alle esigenze del singolo.
Mi dispiace moltissimo perché secondo me mancano OFFERTE SMART che fidelizzino il cliente 🔝.

(Ad esempio fare offerta di 5€ al mese per abbonamento di almeno 2 anni consecutivi o altre offerte simili che valorizzino l’abbonato da più di 5/10 anni)
Mi aspetto una vostra risposta in tal senso 
Grazie 
Roberto Facchini

reviews.title: Disgusting Business Model
reviews.text:
I can't think of any other app that doesn't let you use it while on holidays. Spotify has made a lot of stupid mistakes but this is the last straw. I want to get some music playing and all of a sudden I'm hit with: "Your location doesn't match your profile, upgrade to premium to listen internationally." 
Excuse me??? Are you people out of your minds with greed? I even stuck around when you started putting 3 ads every couple of songs despite it being horribly annoying, and now as a punishment for my loyalty I can't even use your app while visiting family? 
Are you actually humans working at spotify corp?? Are you humans or have you been so consumed by your greed and higher-up bootlicking that you're just husks? This is the stupidest decision your company has ever made, and trust me you guys have made a LOT of incredibly absurd decisions in recent times.

Edit: Before you start saying "you need to change your settings bla bla bla" I'm saying there is absolutely no reason for needing to go through all that hassle just because I'm staying abroad for 3 weeks instead of 2. I don't think having accurate location should even be a requirement to listen to music, I think that's stupid. I appreciate recommending it for data accuracy, but having be obligatory just to listen to music?? Genuinely absurd. I can't even think of any other synonyms of stupid because I'm so confused and disgusted.

...and I write all this as something on a premium plan who spends more than 30 days annually of continuous play-time, if it were me paying for my subscription... my god no I wouldn't.

reviews.title: Premium Family
reviews.text:
I am a member of a Spotify Premium Family plan that is paid for by the account owner (my mother), but I am unable to access the Premium benefits. Even though I am part of the Family plan, my account is not being recognized as Premium, and I cannot use the service we are paying for.

This is very frustrating because the purpose of the Family plan is to allow family members to enjoy Premium access. Unfortunately, in my case, it is not working as expected.

I hope Spotify resolves this issue as soon as possible and provides more effective support for Family plan members. So far, my experience has been very disappointing.

Again we pay monthly fee and it’s not a low amount ! What are your developers doing ?! What are you paying them for ?! Are you 1. lazy to add the customise options 2. Unable to do so ?! Do two versions of Spotify one for paying customers where they will be able to even choose better icon because this one is horrible and customise Home Screen etc. and second one for the ones that aren’t willing to pay. It makes me feel like you don’t appreciate paying customer.

So, after listening to Spotify for 4 months, it’s actually good, here are some stuff I could say:

Pros:

1. The UI is nice, it is simple, yet easy to use, UI friendly
2. The audio is good, I can’t tell a difference with a music quality, but it is good
3. Spatial audio support :) (I listen with my AirPods)
4. So many songs

Cons:

1. Skips are limited on the free version of mobile

Overall: 4.7/5 good listening app.

reviews.title: Bad song recommendation algorithm
reviews.text:
Over the last year I’ve noticed that the quality of the algorithm that plays randomly the songs reduced (when you play one song and other songs that follow are “similar to the one you’ve just played”). The songs became random, poorly made and not for my liking. I can barely find any new music I’d enjoy. Maybe it’s a new way to promote smaller artists? I’m not sure what changed, but the algorithm before was better. 
Another problem is when Spotify plays russian songs after Ukrainian, thinking they’re “similar”, even when I block the russian artists, I still keep hearing their songs randomly being played by Spotify when I listen to Ukrainian songs. 
I hope this can be fixed.

Spotify starts playing on its own and the app reopens even after I’ve force-closed it.

Steps to reproduce:
1) Close/force-quit Spotify.
2) Wait [X minutes] or trigger [Bluetooth connect/disconnect / start the car / press a media key].
3) The app relaunches by itself and begins playback.

Expected result:
The app stays closed and no audio starts.

Actual result:
The app reopens and starts playing unexpectedly.

Frequency:intermittent

What I’ve tried:
- Turned off Autoplay.
- Reinstalled the app and cleared cache/data.
- Logged out everywhere and signed in again.
- Checked background activity/refresh settings.
- Reviewed car/Bluetooth auto-play settings.

This can leave you wondering if the problem lies with you as a listener or if it’s actually the content itself that’s changing. This is purely my personal opinion, shaped by many years of using Spotify. Perhaps it’s time to start exploring alternatives.

reviews.title: Recommendations are completely bad
reviews.text:
The ‘Playlists of the Day’ feature on Spotify tends to include songs I’ve already added to my favorites, so I rarely get introduced to new music. It feels like they’re just reshuffling my own playlist rather than offering fresh discoveries. Additionally, the daily playlists often repeat songs from one another, leading to the same tracks showing up every day. Even songs I’ve marked with a ‘dislike’ still reappear the next day, which defeats the purpose of downvoting tracks. Overall, it’s a bit frustrating when I’m looking for variety but end up hearing the same songs repeatedly.

If I liked a specific song by a particular artist, the recommendations would often just keep recommending me that same song in the following days, instead of introducing me to other songs by that artist. I find this approach quite strange, as it limits the chance to explore more of their music.

reviews.title: Błędny/mylący opis funkcji „Pokazuj tylko lokalne urządzenia” w aplikacji na iOS
reviews.text: Dzień dobry,Chciałbym zgłosić błąd w tłumaczeniu/opisie funkcji w sekcji "Urządzenia" w aplikacji Spotify. Pod przełącznikiem znajduje się tekst: „W menu urządzeń pokazuje tylko urządzenia połączone z siecią lokalną WiFi lub Ethernet”.Ten opis wprowadza użytkowników w błąd. Włączenie tej opcji powoduje UKRYCIE domowych głośników sieciowych (np. Bose czy Sonos działających przez Spotify Connect), mimo że są one w tej samej sieci Wi-Fi. Opis sugeruje coś zupełnie odwrotnego do rzeczywistego działania aplikacji. Proszę o poprawienie tego tekstu, aby jasno informował, że funkcja ta ukrywa inteligentne głośniki sieciowe. Pozdrawiam!

reviews.text: O Spotify tem se transformado em mais uma rede social neste momento, expondo tudo que ouvimos, com quem trocamos músicas, expondo nossas conversas quando compartilhamos o link de uma simples música! Não dá mais para ser algo simples como o YouTube, onde você compartilha uma música com outra pessoa, ao compartilhar uma vida pelo Spotify você compartilha sua vida, coisas que você não pretendia mostrar. E o pior é que não nos foi pedido autorização pra isso! Já foi o tempo de ser um bom aplicativo :)

reviews.title: Modo aleatório numa jam não funciona
reviews.text: Quando duas pessoas estão numa jam e uma coloca músicas na fila de reprodução e a outra também faz a adição de faixa e o dono jam coloca em modo aleatório a fila de reprodução, a ordem ainda continua como a adicionada, sem misturar a ordem das músicas a serem tocadas. Parece q o Spotify não dá mta atenção pra esses detalhes, porque pra eles a única vantagem oferecida aos usuários q pagam é não terem propaganda entre as faixas, como se fosse a vantagem absoluta, apesar q, não sei por que, estou tendo propagandas antes de iniciar alguns podcasts, uma coisa que a equipe poderia me esclarecer pagando plano família. Em se tratando do detalhe anteriormente mencionado gostaria de uma solução, ouvir músicas em ordem aleatório numa jam entre duas pessoas. Aguardo retorno, obrigado.

reviews.title: Premium isn’t ad free…
reviews.text:
l've been a premium user for
YEARS now and one of the features I loved most (and used to tell everyone about) was that, since spotify bought parcast, their podcasts were dynamic ad free. They had a couple advertisements recorded on the audio itself, but it was just for parcast's other podcasts, which was completely fine, since it was just a few seconds long and not very disruptive. However, since a couple months ago, spotify decided to add dynamic ads on parcast’s podcasts, even for premium users! As the subscription isn’t that cheap, I’m seriously reconsidering renovating it, changing instead to apple music and apple podcasts…

reviews.title: Please resolve the issue.
reviews.text: hello. Everything is really cool and convenient, but the main downside is that you can’t listen properly without a premium subscription. Since there’s a 20‑second ad every 2–3 songs, and there are even two ads. For example, you might want to feel sad, do your homework, relax, or think — but because of these ads, instead of enjoying the music, you end up listening to the ads. reviews.title: Ужасно! Терпеть не могу
reviews.text:
Это просто ужасный опыт использования приложения. Реклама появляется буквально после каждой песни, слушать музыку невозможно. Premium-подписка с бесплатным периодом не открывается — кнопки не работают, ничего не загружается при нажатии. Я пробовала даже создать новый аккаунт, но ситуация абсолютно такая же.

Приложение выглядит как будто специально мешает пользоваться бесплатной версией, а платная подписка недоступна. Это крайне раздражает и вызывает ощущение, что сервис работает нестабильно или с ограничениями.

Очень разочарована. Такое ощущение, что приложение просто заставляет терпеть рекламу или уходить.

reviews.title: Why Fix What Wasn’t Broken?
reviews.text:
The new app icon looks great — it feels fresh, modern, and visually appealing. It was actually the reason I decided to update the app.

However, the new font is a huge downgrade. The previous font was much better: clearer, more pleasant to look at, and it matched Spotify’s design perfectly. The new one makes the entire app feel cheaper and less polished.

Playlist titles, album names, and other text elements no longer have the same visual appeal. The old design felt cleaner, more aesthetic, and more premium. Now the interface looks less refined and harder to enjoy.

I genuinely like the new icon, but I strongly prefer the previous typography and overall visual style. I hope Spotify considers bringing it back or giving users a choice between the old and new appearance.

reviews.text: In Kazakhstan, Spotify users face the absence of the Canvas feature, which has long been available in other countries. This tool makes interaction with the service more modern and engaging, allowing artists to visually complement their tracks and strengthen their connection with listeners. The lack of Canvas reduces the overall user experience and puts listeners in Kazakhstan at a disadvantage compared to other regions. We kindly ask Spotify management to consider enabling this feature in our country. This will increase audience satisfaction and improve the perception of the service among local users.

reviews.title: Paying for Premium, Getting Errors🤦‍♂️
reviews.text:
This is honestly one of the most frustrating apps I’ve ever paid for. I have a perfectly good internet connection, every other app works flawlessly, yet this one constantly claims “no internet connection” and refuses to play music.

And that’s just the beginning.

The app randomly freezes, sometimes songs won’t play at all, playlists take forever to load, and sometimes it even logs you out or crashes for no reason. There are moments when it just sits there spinning like it forgot its entire purpose. 

People pay for Premium expecting a smooth experience, yet you still get bugs, playback errors, missing songs, and features that randomly stop working.  

Let’s be honest: if a music streaming app can’t reliably stream music, then something is seriously wrong. Fix the app, fix the servers, and start respecting the users who are actually paying for this service.

reviews.title: Удобный сервис для музыки на каждый день
reviews.text:
Удобный и продуманный сервис. Большая библиотека треков, подкастов и плейлистов позволяет быстро находить музыку под любое настроение. Алгоритмы рекомендаций действительно работают: сервис предлагает новые песни и исполнителей, которые часто совпадают с моими предпочтениями.

Отдельно стоит отметить удобный интерфейс и возможность слушать музыку на разных устройствах без потери качества. Плейлисты легко создавать и редактировать, а функция офлайн-прослушивания особенно полезна в дороге.

Очень нравится.
